verdict.rationale: Claude is a general-purpose AI assistant and model platform, not a cap-table or equity-management service. Ordering audit-ready 409A valuations generated from live cap table data is a category error for this kind of product, and nothing in the evidence shows Claude ships such a service. Generic task scheduling and file creation do not make this valuation axis applicable.

support.subject: As a founder, I can order an audit-ready 409A valuation in-platform, generated from my live cap table data, and get refreshed valuations on schedule
